text: Additional evidence 2026-08-03: fit/OlsSuite now proves an invertible diagonal basis reparameterization transports fitted coefficients, normalized CoefficientCovariance, linear contrast weights/variance, and fitted values. The new test passes 15/15 on JVM and 15/15 on Scala.js. This closes the artifact-level covariance/adjusted-hypothesis evidence for the supported diagonal/permutation transform family; external design-oracle parity remains a separate caveat.
